primaryGoal: Track weekly cumulative KPI trends (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV) within the current quarter to understand week-over-week changes and assess progress toward targets.
assumptions: The cumulative_sum formula correctly resets at the start of each quarter based on quarter_number calculation.
Weekly aggregation captures complete weeks, and 'this week' and 'last week' are clearly defined in the system.
All mandatory filters (Opportunity Type IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer') AND Opportunity Deployment != 'mode') are consistently applied across all data fetches.
The date columns [Opportunity M1 Date] and [Opportunity S0 Date] are accurate and complete for the current quarter.
The measures [Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [f Opportunity M1 Created Count], and [Opportunity S0 Starting ACV] are correctly populated and represent the intended business metrics.

phases.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Trend Analysis
phases.phaseDescription: Calculate the cumulative M1 ACV from the start of the current quarter on a weekly basis, identify the change from last week to this week, and compute percentage change to assess momentum.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1: M1 ACV Cumulative by Week for Current Quarter
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve weekly cumulative M1 ACV values for the current quarter to enable week-over-week comparison.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity M1 Date] aggregated at weekly level, cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] is 'This Quarter', [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'. Aggregation: Weekly granularity.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Calculate the cumulative sum of [Opportunity M1 Starting ACV] by [Opportunity M1 Date], restarting for each quarter using the formula cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Apply filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] is 'This Quarter', [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), and [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'. Aggregate the result at weekly granularity. Include columns: week of [Opportunity M1 Date] and the cumulative M1 ACV value.
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Trend Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1: Calculate M1 ACV for Last Week and This Week
analysisSteps.aggregation: Cumulative M1 ACV value (already calculated in fetch)
analysisSteps.question: What was the cumulative M1 ACV at the end of last week versus the end of this week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the fetched data, identify the cumulative M1 ACV value for the most recent complete week (this week) and the week immediately preceding it (last week). Extract these two values: 'M1 ACV until last week' and 'M1 ACV until this week'. Report both values clearly.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Trend Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 2: Calculate M1 ACV Change and Percentage Change
analysisSteps.aggregation: Difference and percentage difference between two cumulative values
analysisSteps.question: What is the absolute change and percentage change in M1 ACV from last week to this week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Calculate the absolute change in M1 ACV: (M1 ACV until this week) - (M1 ACV until last week). Then calculate the percentage change: [(M1 ACV until this week - M1 ACV until last week) / M1 ACV until last week] * 100. Present the results in a summary format: 'M1 ACV until last week', 'M1 ACV until this week', 'Absolute change', 'Percentage change'. Interpret whether the trend is positive (increasing) or negative (decreasing).
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Trend Analysis

phases.phaseDescription: Synthesize the week-over-week changes across all three KPIs to provide a holistic view of performance trends and identify which KPIs are on track versus those requiring attention.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 4: No Additional Fetch Required (Synthesis Step)
fetchSteps.objective: Consolidate insights from Phases 1, 2, and 3 to create a unified performance dashboard view.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Results from Analysis 1.1.2 (M1 ACV), Analysis 2.1.2 (M1 Count), and Analysis 3.1.2 (S0 ACV).
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: N/A - This is a synthesis step using previously fetched and analyzed data.

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 7: Consolidated KPI Dashboard
analysisSteps.groupBy: KPI Name (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV)
analysisSteps.question: How are all three KPIs trending week-over-week, and which KPIs show the strongest or weakest momentum?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Create a consolidated summary table with the following structure: | KPI Name | Value Until Last Week | Value Until This Week | Absolute Change | Percentage Change | Trend Assessment |. Populate this table with data from M1 ACV (Analysis 1.1.2), M1 Count (Analysis 2.1.2), and S0 ACV (Analysis 3.1.2). For each KPI, provide a brief trend assessment (e.g., 'Strong Growth', 'Moderate Growth', 'Flat', 'Declining'). Identify which KPI shows the highest percentage growth and which shows the lowest or negative growth. Provide actionable recommendations: if any KPI is declining or flat, suggest areas for investigation (e.g., pipeline generation, conversion rates, sales team activity).
